about: Account master-key rotation (packages/protocol/src/accountKeyRotation.ts). Every port builds each envelope's `canonical` from its `fields`, reproduces every Ed25519 signature (deterministic) and the X-Wing seal (`delivery.xwing`, fixed randomness) byte for byte, and gives each case its `expect`: `hopCases` through the one-hop verify, `pqCases` through the companion verify (bindings from `bindings`, `now` = `now`), `deliveryCases` through the delivery open, `plaintextCases`, `keptCases`, `derivedCases`. `chainCases` start from `chainStart` and are the box's (TypeScript only). Hex is lowercase; a new IRK is version 1 of `newIrkScheme`.
